title: Toward Governance-Aware Autonomous GIS: A Narrative Review of Ethical and Privacy Risks in LLM-Enabled GeoAI
abstract: arXiv:2609.16232v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI) powered by large language models (LLMs) is expanding the capacity to query, generate, and interpret spatial information through natural-language interfaces and agentic autonomous GIS workflows. This capability creates governance challenges that general AI ethics discussions do not fully capture, including passive location inference from mobility traces, spatially structured bias amplification driven by spatial autocorrelation and scale effects, hallucinated spatial facts, and uncertainty compounding across multimodal geospatial inputs. This narrative review identifies eight recurring issues in LLM-enabled GeoAI: data provenance and consent, spatial privacy and inference risk, algorithmic bias and spatial inequity, spatial mechanisms as structural risk (spatial autocorrelation, the modifiable areal unit problem, and scale effects), LLM-specific technical risks, explainability, policy and regulato

translated_title: 迈向治理感知的自主GIS：LLM赋能GeoAI中伦理与隐私风险的叙述性综述
translated_abstract: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的地理空间人工智能（GeoAI）正在通过自然语言接口和智能体式自主GIS工作流，扩展查询、生成和解释空间信息的能力。这种能力带来了一些治理挑战，而一般性的人工智能伦理讨论未能充分涵盖这些挑战，包括从移动轨迹中进行被动位置推断、由空间自相关和尺度效应驱动的空间结构化偏见放大、幻觉空间事实，以及跨多模态地理空间输入的不确定性复合效应。本叙述性综述识别了LLM赋能GeoAI中的八个反复出现的问题：数据来源与知情同意、空间隐私与推断风险、算法偏见与空间不平等、作为结构性风险的空间机制（空间自相关、可修改面积单元问题和尺度效应）、LLM特有的技术风险、可解释性、政策与监管……
tldr: 本文通过叙述性综述系统识别了LLM赋能GeoAI中的八大伦理与隐私风险，并倡导构建具备治理意识的自主GIS框架。
en_tdlr: This narrative review systematically identifies eight recurring ethical and privacy risks in LLM-enabled GeoAI and advocates for building governance-aware autonomous GIS frameworks.
